title: How an Optional Supplemental Benefit Rider Comes to an End
content:
One of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders ends when the member cancels it, when the medical plan it hangs on ends, or when its premium is never paid.

## 1. The cancellation on record

The rider cancellation is recorded on a rider service intake with the request action for a rider cancellation and an intake status of recorded, awaiting the member's signature, or under review. This is read before the rider is brought to an end, from the member's own rider service requests: the reference of the intake, what it asks for and where it stands.

## 2. Who may cancel, and from when

Only the member may cancel a rider they are paying for, and the cancellation takes effect on the date the tier's cancellation rule produces from the day the request was received.

## 3. The minimum holding period

A rider may not be cancelled before the tier's minimum holding months have passed, and a member asking earlier is told the date they may cancel and what they would otherwise still owe.

## 4. Where the medical plan ends

When the medical plan ends the rider ends on the same day without the member having to ask, and the rider premium for months after that day is credited back.

## 5. Services on or before the end date

Services given on or before the rider end date are still paid even where the claim reaches the plan afterwards, so a member who had treatment on their last covered day keeps the benefit.

## 6. What ending a rider does not end

Ending a rider does not end the allowance card or the medical plan, and a member who meant to end everything is asked plainly which cover they want stopped.

## Condition, judgement and result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A cancellation intake stands recorded, awaiting the member's signature, or under review | The cancellation is on record | The rider may be brought to an end |
| Somebody other than the member asks for the cancellation | Only the member may cancel a rider they are paying for | The cancellation is not taken from them |
| The tier's minimum holding months have not passed | The rider is inside its minimum holding period | It may not be cancelled yet; the member is told the date they may |
| The medical plan the rider hangs on ends | The rider ends the same day | No request is needed, and premium for months after that day is credited back |
| A service was given on the rider end date, the claim arriving later | Services on or before the end date are still paid | The benefit stands |
